title: Braid-Word Functor Boundary
interpretation: A full braid-word functor for the local K33 cycle code must use four two-state Fibonacci fusion blocks, one per independent rectangle-cycle bit. Any two-block construction is a quotient of H1(K33;F2), not the full [9,4,4] code.
boundary: This is a register/braid-module boundary theorem. The next missing object is an explicit generator-respecting map from K33 rectangle moves or lift-selector moves to Fibonacci braid words.
